question: What was the average monthly consumption of customers in SME for the year 2013?
actual_sql:
SELECT AVG(y.consumption) AS avg_monthly_consumption
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.segment = 'SME'
  AND y.date LIKE '2013%'
expected_response: {"evidence": "Average Monthly consumption = AVG(Consumption) / 12; Year 2013 can be presented as Between 201301 And 201312; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year."}
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(T2.consumption) / NULLIF(12, 0) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE SUBSTRING(T2.date FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2013' AND T1.segment = 'SME'
evidence: Average Monthly consumption = AVG(Consumption) / 12; Year 2013 can be presented as Between 201301 And 201312; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.
